title: 第25章 晨曦的教育方式第26章 大夏帝国历史
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
林道打开房门，正好看到咬牙切齿的王胖子，有些不好意思道：“抱歉哈，我戴着耳机睡着了，真的很抱歉王胖子。”
他心里非常清楚，王云浩完全是出于真心实意地担忧他的安危。
毕竟，如果不是真的关心一个人，又有谁会愿意花费足足半个小时的时间，不停地敲门呢？要知道，他们俩相识还未满一天。
当看到林道出现在房门口时，王云浩那原本焦急恼怒的语气，稍稍缓和了下来，但仍有些不爽地说道：“切！我都差点儿跑去，把老师给叫过来了，还有以后不许叫我胖子。”
然而，林道却像是没听到一般，随口应道：“知道了，王胖子。”
说完，更是毫不在意地伸出手，一把搂住了王云浩那宽厚的肩膀，就这样朝着楼下走去。
被搂着肩膀的王云浩憋红了脸，再次强调道：“都说了不要叫我胖子！”
就在这时，两人一同走下楼来，碰巧遇见了另外两位室友。
其中一位戴着厚厚的眼镜，身材略显瘦弱单薄，一副白面书生模样，据介绍得知他是法学专科的，名叫张三。
让林道不由多瞅了几眼。
而另一位则身材高大，活脱脱的东北大汉形象，不仅嗓门洪亮，是建筑工程专业的学生，名字叫做吴磊。
大家相互打过招呼之后，便纷纷开始自我介绍起来，并简单聊了几句彼此的情况和兴趣爱好等等。
最后，众人约定好了等会，其他两位室友也都到齐之后，明天晚上一起出去好好聚个餐，增进一下感情。
当睌林道在王云浩痛心疾首的表情中，又从清云轩饱餐了一顿，说实话清云轩饭菜着实不错。
翌日清晨，林道正在山海造化珠内，修炼《道临霸体功》功法，在心法的牵引体内气血演化为气血洪炉。
林道按照元神内的，炼体图与气血洪炉相互配合，搬运自身气血，进行周天运转，淬炼气血，冲刷自身体魄与筋络。
林道尽管抵达了搬血境极致，因此，他依旧坚持不懈着修炼，因为他明白只有持之以恒的努力，才能够逐渐习惯，不让他在悠闲的生活消磨意志。
当林道结束自身的修炼之后，稍作休息调整，又重新修炼上世的武术拳法。
林道虽然还无法运用武道元神的力量。
但经过探究，他发现武道元神也具备强大的推演能力。

更是比金色识海更加优异，林道只要想推演战技，武道元神就会按照他的想法，就会自动推演出适合他的战技。
不仅如此，它还拥有将自身推演出来的战技以及功法烙印在元神中。
如此一来，只要林道需要，便能随时随地调用这些战技，使其如同身体本能一般，自然流畅地施展出来。
更为震惊的是，武道元神竟然还能够依据林道自身的情况，持续不断地对其所创造的，功法和战技进行优化改进。
武道元神就像，拥有绝对理智的林道，犹如天道。
林道从山海造化珠中出来，也幸亏有它，不然他要找修炼场所，又要花费不少时间，更重要的还不够隐蔽。
林道出来时，宿舍一片安静，今天是晨曦学府，新生报到的最后一天，估计明天才有课，都在抓紧睡最后一天。
他今天想去一趟图书馆，了解一下，大夏的历史背景，没办法原主对历史了解太浅薄了，一些情况就了解的大概。
content_en:
Lin Dao opened the door and saw Fatty Wang gritting his teeth. He said a little embarrassedly: "I'm sorry, I fell asleep with my headphones on. I'm really sorry about Fatty Wang."
He knew very well that Wang Yunhao was completely sincerely worried about his safety.
After all, if you don't really care about someone, who would be willing to spend half an hour knocking on the door? You know, they have known each other for less than a day.
When he saw Lin Dao appear at the door of the room, Wang Yunhao's originally anxious and angry tone softened slightly, but he still said unhappily: "Tch! I almost ran and called the teacher over. Don't call me fat in the future."
However, Lin Dao seemed not to hear it and responded casually: "I know, Fatty Wang."
After saying that, he reached out his hand nonchalantly, hugged Wang Yunhao's broad shoulders, and walked downstairs.
Wang Yunhao, who was hugged by the shoulders, suppressed his blush and emphasized again: "I told you not to call me fat!"
At this moment, the two of them walked downstairs together and happened to meet two other roommates.
One of them wore thick glasses, was slightly thin and frail, and looked like a white-faced scholar. According to the introduction, he was a law major named Zhang San.
Lin Dao couldn't help but take a few more glances.
The other one is tall and looks like a big man from Northeast China. Not only does he have a loud voice, he is a student majoring in construction engineering, and his name is Wu Lei.
After everyone greeted each other, they began to introduce themselves and briefly chatted about each other's situation, interests and hobbies.
Finally, everyone agreed that after the other two roommates had arrived, they would go out to have a good dinner together tomorrow night to enhance their relationship.
When Lin Dao looked at Wang Yunhao's heartbroken expression, he had another meal at Qingyunxuan. To be honest, the food at Qingyunxuan was really good.
In the early morning of the next day, Lin Dao was practicing the "Dao Lin Ba Ti Kung" in the Shanhai Fortune Pearl. Under the guidance of his mind, the qi and blood in his body evolved into a qi and blood furnace.
Lin Dao cooperated with the body refining diagram and the Qi and Blood Furnace according to the inner soul, transporting his own Qi and blood, circulating around the sky, tempering the Qi and blood, and flushing his body and muscles.
Although Lin Dao has reached the ultimate level of moving blood, he still persists in practicing because he understands that only through persistent efforts can he gradually get used to it and prevent his leisurely life from wearing away his will.
After Lin Dao finished his training, he took a short rest and adjusted, and then started to practice the martial arts techniques of the previous life again.
Although Lin Dao is still unable to use the power of martial arts soul.
But after some research, he discovered that the martial arts soul also had powerful deduction capabilities.
It is even more superior than the Golden Sea of ​​Consciousness. As long as Lin Dao wants to deduce combat skills, the martial arts soul will automatically deduce combat skills suitable for him according to his ideas.
Not only that, it also has the combat skills and techniques that it has derived from itself that are imprinted in its soul.
In this way, as long as Lin Dao needs it, he can call on these combat skills anytime and anywhere, so that they can be displayed naturally and smoothly like the instinct of the body.
What is even more shocking is that the martial arts Yuanshen can continuously optimize and improve the exercises and combat skills he created based on Lin Dao's own situation.
The soul of martial arts is like Lin Dao, who possesses absolute rationality, just like the way of heaven.
Lin Dao came out of the Mountain and Sea Creation Pearl. Fortunately, he had it. Otherwise, it would have taken a lot of time for him to find a place to practice. More importantly, it was not concealed enough.
When Lin Dao came out, the dormitory was quiet. Today is the last day of registration at Chenxi Academy. It is estimated that there will be no classes until tomorrow, so everyone is rushing to sleep for the last day.
He wanted to go to the library today to learn about the historical background of Daxia. Unfortunately, the original owner's understanding of history was too shallow and he only had a rough understanding of some situations.
